response.justification: The candidate lacks direct C++ experience in industrial automation or high-performance systems, despite having extensive full-stack and web-focused work; his C++ exposure is limited to a brief academic/thesis project and NI LabWindows, which does not meet the role’s core requirements for secure, scalable, multi-threaded C++ development in industrial IoT or IEC 62443 environments.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience with modern tools
Demonstrated leadership in open-source and community technical initiatives
Proven ability to deliver complex systems across diverse domains (GIS, AI, automation)
concerns: Minimal recent or relevant C++ work; no evidence of STL, multi-threading, or SDL in professional context
No exposure to industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850) or IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang, not aligned with C++-centric role requirements
